caption: Our import landed as one test contact with a made up example.com address in Test List. The second row is the account itself and is hidden, as is the account menu.
The drag and drop builder opened a ready Black Friday template with dummy text for our draft Test newsletter. We sent nothing, not even a test e-mail.
The campaign stayed a draft, so the delivered, opened and clicks columns are empty. The account menu is hidden.
In the app the paid plans show in US dollars: Standard $9 and Professional $15 a month at 500 subscribers, with 15% off if you pay 3 months upfront. We did not reach the payment step.
Delete account is easy to find at the bottom of General settings. We did not click it. The address, signature and account menu are hidden.
